"All right. Show me when we work together. That's all."
"Nobody's settled the ambush against me yet."
The ground remembers.
No one saw Luciana leave. Just trees.

You say nothing. The silence sits at the fire with everyone else.
Counted.
"Anyway — I should get going."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"See you around."
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Honest. I can work with honest."
"Sassafras — crush the leaf, smell it, taste the stem. That's how you know it."
"a burned farmhouse — remember the shape of it. It's real, and it's worth knowing."
"Hey — Mine's simple: learn one useful thing a week. This week it's making do. A plan's just a direction you argue with."
"Still on your plan here."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"I'll keep it to myself. What's on your mind?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Have you heard what they're calling Grief Counselor? Cameron is pushing 'Loud-Eyes'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
"All right. Thank you for telling me."
They glance at the fire, then back. The quiet doesn't seem to bother them.
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:

lines: d10: 📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
d10: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hugo Foley is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d10: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d10: 🕯️ Hugo Foley is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d10: What Hugo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d10: "Hugo's gone." Jian looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hugo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d10: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Seo-ha blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d10: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d10: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
